items.notes: Core claim 5 is missing: the answer never compares lexical, vector and hybrid retrieval on one evidence base, nor warns that semantic similarity or a top result does not certify support.

Core claims 4 and 5 are missing: there is no treatment of redaction occurring only after sensitive bytes have traversed intermediate paths, and nothing on retained agent-interaction records; per-copy access enforcement and revocation are only gestured at.
No core claim is missing: the synthetic 60 percent closed-record case and the pinned comparison conditions are covered, with extended statistics only implicit.
Core claim 5 is missing: quorum arithmetic on a misconfigured voter set, where adding a voter raises the required majority without increasing tolerated failures, is never discussed.
No core claim is missing: locked prepared state, commit-point logging, vote-as-input, contraindication and the saga trade-off are covered, though recovery authority is only lightly specified.
